signalPath.title: Signal Path
signalPath.formatExplanation: The MPD status describes a reported decoded format, not the original codec or the signal received by the DAC. It does not verify Hi-Res, native DSD or bit-perfect playback.
signalPath.sharedExplanation: ALSA default follows system routing, which may involve PipeWire, PulseAudio or dmix, with possible mixing and conversion. The endpoint is not measured here.

assessment.help: Evaluates the playing ALSA output, rate, channels, PCM capacity and reported processing. It is independent of the DAC model or kernel release. It is not a comparison of the current track’s samples.

evidence.title: Matching reference test
evidence.reference: {{frames}} PCM frames preserved, with a continuous join across {{tracks}} tracks.
evidence.help: In this test, reference samples reached the USB requests intact. It is additional evidence for this engine, DAC, format and kernel combination; it does not restrict other DACs or compare the current track.

seal.label: Bit-perfect
seal.scope: The badge indicates observed Direct route conditions with the identified engine: PCM with preserved rate/channels and sufficient integer capacity, or native DSD/DoP with confirmed negotiated transport and matching DSD rate, PCM volume at 100%, DSD with software gain bypassed, and no reported processing changes. Engine validation includes file tests for DSD/DoP; this is not a DSD USB test on your DAC. It does not continuously compare track samples or measure internal DAC processing. Changes may take the buffer duration to reach the output. The badge refers to the route after decoding; it does not certify that the source file is lossless. While muted, the badge continues to indicate the route configuration; content is replaced with silence. On unmute, volume and all other conditions are evaluated again.

codes.cue_checks_not_performed: CUE present, without tag or numbering checks

checks.canonicalization_discarded_entries: Entries discarded when grouping the catalog

limits.membership: Inspection covers only tracks associated with this album by the current catalog. It does not search for missing tracks or entries discarded during that grouping.
limits.dates: Years are compared only in valid year, year-month or year-month-day dates. Different precision within the same year is not a divergence. Original text is preserved; an uninterpretable date is not an absent date.
limits.numbers: An unobtained number may mean a missing tag or a value that could not be interpreted. We do not assume disc 1 or missing tracks. Numbers are compared only with positive declared totals.
limits.conflicts: Repeated positive disc and track numbers are only a possible conflict. They do not prove duplicate files; the same track number on different discs is legitimate. File content is not compared.
limits.cue: CUE presence is reported, but its tags and numbering are not checked. Reading all physical files does not make CUE coverage complete.
limits.snapshot: This result reflects one read, not an atomic snapshot: files are read at different times and can change during inspection.
limits.invalidation: Closing this screen or invalidating the result discards replies in this interface. It does not cancel a file read that has already started.

libraryRecovery.title: Recover library
libraryRecovery.explanation: Sonante needs to check the library before continuing. This check does not change your data or start playback.
libraryRecovery.exporting: Choose where to save the report…
libraryRecovery.failed: The library check could not be completed. Earlier information is for reference only. Try checking again.
libraryRecovery.cancelFailed: The check was dismissed in this window, but cancellation was not confirmed.
libraryRecovery.exportFailed: The report could not be saved. Check the library again before trying to save it.
libraryRecovery.exported: Report saved, without personal paths or credentials.
libraryRecovery.unavailable: Recovery could not be prepared. Open the technical details and save the report to get help.
libraryRecovery.guidance: Preserve the library files. Save this report to guide review and the choice of a complete backup. Do not delete records or folders to bypass the startup block.
libraryRecovery.queueVersion: Queue backup in the record: version {{version}}.
libraryRecovery.observationOnly: This observation does not prove catalog coverage or restoration of the queue or music. The report describes this moment; another application may change the files later.

config.previous: Configuration matches the recorded previous state.
config.next: Configuration matches the recorded next state.
config.unbound: Configuration is not proven to belong to a recoverable state.

reasons.intent_valid: A pending folder transaction has an intact record. This does not prove completion.
reasons.intent_invalid: The transaction record is invalid, incomplete, or cannot be read safely.
reasons.orphan_staging: A staged library generation has no record proving its completion.
reasons.config_invalid: Configuration could not be safely validated.
reasons.config_divergent: Configuration differs from both states in the transaction record.
reasons.mirror_missing: The main library generation is missing.
reasons.mirror_invalid: A generation or its manifest could not be safely validated.
reasons.generation_divergent: An observed generation differs from the identities recorded in the transaction.
reasons.database_missing: The local catalog database is missing.
reasons.database_unproven: The database is present, but catalog coverage is unproven. Analysis may read database bytes to check the recovery set; this does not validate its catalog or reindex it.
reasons.ledger_missing: The identity history file pair is missing or incomplete. IDs will not be recreated automatically.
reasons.ledger_divergent: Identity history or its anchor could not be validated against the observed manifests.
reasons.unsafe_entry: A file or directory is unavailable, replaced, or fails safety checks.
reasons.filesystem_changed: Files changed or became unavailable during analysis. Analyze again before deciding.
reasons.ownership_unknown: This analysis does not prove exclusive profile ownership or the absence of another instance.
reasons.no_pending_marker: No transaction record or staged generation was found. This does not enable audio or confirm a valid configuration.
reasons.recovery_set_unproven: The recovery set is missing, incomplete, changed, or does not meet safe execution requirements.

libraryRecovery.executionFailed: Recovery could not be confirmed. Part of the library may have changed. Preserve the files and check again.
libraryRecovery.reopenFailed: The app could not reopen. Close Sonante normally and open it again to check the library state.
libraryRecovery.executing: Creating a backup, executing and validating the plan…
libraryRecovery.reopening: Closing Sonante. Open it again afterward…
libraryRecovery.completed: Library recovered. Reopen Sonante to continue.
libraryRecovery.backupRetained: The recovery backup was kept. Music starts only when you request it.
libraryRecovery.summaryImpact: Music, favorites and playlists will be preserved. Folders from the interrupted attempt may be left out and the queue may return to its earlier state. Playback will remain stopped.
libraryRecovery.impact: The plan rechecks files and source identities before applying changes to the active state. Protection records and backups may be created before a later failure. The plan preserves current favorites, playlists and reserved IDs. Completed restoration returns configuration and catalog to the proven state; an earlier queue is restored only with specific evidence. References to new sources may become unavailable.
libraryRecovery.proof: The previous catalog contains {{tracks}} tracks. The control backup requires at least {{bytes}} bytes, plus the virtual structure. Missing space or current evidence keeps audio blocked.
libraryRecovery.noMusicBackup: This backup does not copy music or NAS data. It cannot restore physical music that was changed or removed.
libraryRecovery.resumePlan: This option resumes the interrupted change using data that could be confirmed.
libraryRecovery.analysisCancelled: The check was dismissed in this window. Late results will be ignored.
libraryRecovery.executionCancelled: Cancellation requested. Work termination and the result are still unconfirmed. Preserve the files.
libraryRecovery.executionCancelFailed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. Recovery may still be running; preserve the files.
libraryRecovery.sessionUnconfirmed: Recovery completion is unconfirmed. Reopening remains blocked.
libraryRecovery.priorAnalysis: Earlier information, for reference only. Check again before continuing.
libraryRecovery.proofUnavailable: The quantities in this summary are unconfirmed.
libraryRecovery.reportV1: The report is always an analysis snapshot and does not include the new attempt diagnosis. Export checks again that the analysis is still current.
libraryRecovery.reportPriorRefused: Export of an earlier analysis is always refused. Run a new current manual analysis before requesting another report.

failureClass.legacy_unknown: The detailed cause of this attempt could not be determined.
failureClass.cancellation_observed: A check observed cancellation. Work termination and the final result are unconfirmed.
failureClass.preflight_unconfirmed: The requirements for this plan could not be confirmed.
failureClass.plan_context_changed: The plan context changed and this attempt was not confirmed.
failureClass.offered_context_unconfirmed: The context observed in the offer could not be confirmed for this attempt.
failureClass.local_journal_context_unconfirmed: The context of the local journal used in this attempt could not be confirmed.
failureClass.catalog_mismatch_observed: The checked catalog did not match what was expected during the check.

boundary.protocol_check: Check category: protocol checks. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.readonly_preflight: Check category: plan inspection. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.protection_records: Check category: protection records. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.local_journal_binding: Check category: local journal binding. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.catalog_check: Check category: catalog check. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.generation_namespace: Check category: generation names. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.control_writes: Check category: profile controls. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.final_validation: Check category: final validation. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.commit_retention: Check category: commit or retention. This does not indicate a linear phase.
boundary.unknown: Check category: unconfirmed category. This does not indicate a linear phase.

effect.protection: May have been issued in this attempt: protection records. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.live_generation_namespace: May have been issued in this attempt: live generation names. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.control_temporary: May have been issued in this attempt: temporary controls. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.canonical_control: May have been issued in this attempt: canonical controls. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.retention: May have been issued in this attempt: file and record retention. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.backup_namespace: May have been issued in this attempt: backup names. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.validator_or_child_unknown: May have been issued in this attempt: unconfirmed auxiliary or external process effects. The effect and its completion are not confirmed.
effect.opaque_callback: Auxiliary actions with undetailed results may have been requested.

knowledge.executor_captured: Summary captured when the executor returned; not a post-error measurement of the whole state.
knowledge.unknown_boundary: No reliable detailed diagnosis is available for this boundary. Preserve current files and records.

inherited.journal_and_blocked_read: Local and blocked-state records were read. This does not prove the absence of other effects.
inherited.committed_name_not_completed: A commit record name was observed; this does not prove session completion.

outcome.not_attempted: No attempt is captured in this diagnosis. This does not authorize execution.
outcome.unconfirmed: An attempt was reserved, but its completion is not confirmed.
outcome.failed: An error return was recorded. Detailed cause information may still be unknown.
outcome.state_returned_ok: A successful attempt return was recorded. This snapshot does not confirm completion of this session or enable reopening.

freshness.current: Current at the instant of the query; it may change afterward.
freshness.stale: Diagnosis from an earlier attempt, for information only.

unavailableReason.invalid_lookup: The query association could not be confirmed.
unavailableReason.shutdown: The query is unavailable during shutdown.
unavailableReason.not_captured_or_unavailable: No reliable diagnosis is available for this query.

diagnostic.title: Attempt information
diagnostic.prior: Information from an earlier attempt, retained during reanalysis. It does not describe a new attempt.
diagnostic.informationOnly: This snapshot shows only what was recorded. It does not enable execution, reopening or session completion.
diagnostic.unknown: No reliable finite information is available for this query. This does not confirm the absence of effects.
diagnostic.queryUnavailable: A query for this same attempt provided no additional reliable information. The earlier error record was retained.
diagnostic.unknownEffects: Reliable effect details are unavailable for this attempt. Broad uncertainty confirms neither that every effect occurred nor that files stayed unchanged.
diagnostic.mayOnly: The possibilities below confirm neither effects nor termination. An absent item also does not prove that nothing changed.
diagnostic.guidance: Preserve current files and records. When appropriate, check access to the same original sources and run a new manual analysis or seek support. Do not delete or reset data to bypass startup checks.

status.eligible_at_observation: Inspection observed offer requirements at that instant. Execution requires its own checks again.
status.ineligible: Inspection did not find an eligible offer for this set.
status.unconfirmed: Inspection did not confirm an offer for this set.

reason.ownership_unconfirmed: The exclusivity needed for inspection could not be confirmed.
reason.planning_unconfirmed: The offer requirements could not be confirmed during this inspection.
reason.plan_changed: The observed plan changed. A new analysis is required before another offer.
reason.historical_mismatch: Historical identities are incompatible with the observed set. Preserve records; do not recreate IDs to bypass this refusal.
reason.historical_proof_incomparable: The observed history could not be compared with the required evidence. Preserve data and seek guidance for a proven restoration.
reason.original_root_unavailable: An original source required by inspection was unavailable. Check access to that same original source and run a new manual analysis.
reason.original_root_permission_denied: Reading an original source was denied by permissions. Check access to that same source without changing history.
reason.origin_unconfirmed: The original source identity could not be confirmed. This does not prove music loss.
reason.ledger_invalid: The history record could not be validated. Preserve its files; do not delete or reset it.
reason.ledger_extension_unconfirmed: History continuity was not proven. New IDs do not repair this missing evidence.
reason.manifest_unconfirmed: The manifest binding to the observed set was not confirmed.
reason.unsupported_format: A record format is not supported by this check. Recovery will not run with this diagnosis. Preserve files and records; do not delete or reset data. Seek support for that format and save the analysis report to guide review.
reason.unsafe_or_ambiguous: Inspection found an unsafe or ambiguous situation and did not confirm an offer.
reason.snapshot_changed: Observed data changed during inspection. Another manual analysis can reassess the situation.
reason.incomplete_set: The set required by inspection was incomplete. Preserve available files and seek a proven complete backup.
reason.cancelled: Inspection observed cancellation. This does not confirm termination of other work.
reason.unknown: No reliable detailed explanation is available for this offer. Preserve files and records.

role.confirmed: Observed reference: state confirmed during inspection.

assessment.scope: This explanation is limited to offer inspection. It neither validates the entire observation nor enables execution or reopening.
